summary: As of October 28, 2026, junk-bond spreads are 3.14 percentage points and are down 0.13 percentage points over five trading days. Investment-grade spreads are down 0.02 percentage points over those same five trading days. The CCC-minus-BB gap is 11.23 percentage points. Of the 0.23 percentage-point move in the all-in junk yield, 0.13 was the credit spread and 0.10 was Treasury rates. The 10-year yield is 5.05 percent as of October 28, 2026 and the 30-year is 5.37 percent as of October 28, 2026, a gap of 0.32 percentage points. Brent is 111.53 dollars a barrel as of October 29, 2026 (-1.45 percent over five trading days), and the curve is an unpublished curve shape. The 5-year inflation breakeven is 2.47 percent as of October 29, 2026, up 0.02 percentage points over five observations. The 10-year real yield is 2.67 percent as of October 28, 2026. The broad dollar index is 121.32 as of October 23, 2026, +0.77 index points over 20 observations. VIX is 16.91 as of October 28, 2026. The Fed balance sheet is 6.75 trillion dollars as of October 28, 2026, up 3 billion dollars over the latest four weekly observations. Reserve balances are 2.89 trillion dollars as of October 28, 2026, down 54 billion dollars over the latest four weekly observations. Overnight reverse repo is 0.353 billion dollars as of October 29, 2026, up 0.153 billion over the latest four observations.
